title: Vector-Valued Distributional Reinforcement Learning Policy Evaluation: A Hilbert Space Embedding Approach
abstract: arXiv:2601.18952v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose Kernel Embedding Distributional Reinforcement Learning (KE-DRL) an offline method to estimate kernel mean embeddings of conditional multivariate return distributions from observed offline trajectories with continuous state-action inputs and vector-valued rewards. KE-DRL approximates the conditional embedding and estimates its a finite-dictionary representation coefficients through a maximum mean discrepancy Bellman criterion. For a regular class of return distributions, we show that a Mat\'ern embedding and a Bellman-invariant Sobolev-moment class identifies the unique distributional Bellman fixed point and and derive a H\"older-type bound that controls Wasserstein error by the population embedding Bellman residual. For directly observed responses, we provide finite-sample and uniform error bounds for a regularized conditional mean embedding estimator. Simulation experiments evaluate pointwise embedding recovery against Mo

translated_title: 向量值分布式强化学习策略评估：一种希尔伯特空间嵌入方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了核嵌入分布式强化学习，这是一种离线方法，用于从具有连续状态-动作输入和向量值奖励的观测离线轨迹中估计条件多元回报分布的核均值嵌入。KE-DRL 通过最大均值差异 Bellman 准则逼近条件嵌入，并估计其有限字典表示系数。对于一类正则的回报分布，我们证明了 Matérn 嵌入与 Bellman 不变的 Sobolev 矩类可以识别唯一的分布式 Bellman 不动点，并推导出一个 Hölder 型界，该界通过总体嵌入 Bellman 残差来控制 Wasserstein 误差。对于直接观测的响应，我们为正则化条件均值嵌入估计器提供了有限样本和一致误差界。仿真实验评估了逐点嵌入的恢复效果……
tldr: 该论文提出了 KE-DRL，一种基于核均值嵌入的离线分布式强化学习策略评估方法，能够处理向量值奖励，并从理论上证明了唯一分布式 Bellman 不动点的可识别性以及由 Bellman 残差控制 Wasserstein 误差的 Hölder 型界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes KE-DRL, an offline distributional reinforcement learning policy evaluation method based on kernel mean embeddings that handles vector-valued rewards, and provides theoretical guarantees including identifiability of the unique distributional Bellman fixed point and a Hölder-type bound controlling Wasserstein error by the Bellman residual.
